title: Lesson Tab Card
summary: Make a clear guitar lesson card during the lesson.
user: Guitar teachers and self-teaching players who need to type a quick, legible chord or scale handout during a lesson.
smallest_useful_product: A static keyboard-first editor with a six-string chord grid, fingering, one short tab line, validation, SVG and PNG export, and an encoded share link.
constraints: No bundled song or tab corpus.
Encode shared cards in the browser.
